caption: The drawing depicts a section of a wooden staircase featuring a prominent, ornately carved newel post in the foreground on the left side, which is cylindrical with decorative rectangular and diamond-shaped patterns and vertical grooves. Adjacent to the newel post is a stair railing supported by a series of turned and carved balusters, each with distinct spindle shapes and detailed engravings. The staircase treads are covered with dark teal or green carpet, contrasting with the brown and beige tones of the polished wood elements. The background consists of a plain beige wall following the upward angle of the staircase. The overall composition is angled slightly from the side, providing a partial view of the steps and balusters while focusing on the details of the newel post and the intricate woodwork. Shadows are present to the left and beneath the staircase, emphasizing depth and dimension.
title: Newel Post
